tasks.title: Standard 0.5.0: add task.scope.files_touched schema field, conformance fixtures, and release-prep
definition_of_done: `standard/schemas/task.schema.json` has a new optional top-level `scope` object property with an `additionalProperties: false` constraint containing a `files_touched` string-array sub-field (uniqueItems, minLength 1 per item).

At least one new fixture file under `standard/conformance/fixtures/` demonstrates two tasks that share a file via `scope.files_touched`; all existing fixtures continue to validate without modification.
`standard/CHANGELOG.md` contains a new `## 0.5.0` section documenting the additive schema change.
The Standard conformance Vitest suite passes green with the new fixture included.
acceptance_criteria: `standard/schemas/task.schema.json` validates a task document that includes `scope.files_touched: ["reference-impl/lib/cli.ts"]` without AJV errors.
`standard/schemas/task.schema.json` validates a task document that omits `scope` entirely (field is optional, non-breaking).
A task document with `scope: { unknownField: true }` fails AJV validation due to `additionalProperties: false` on the `scope` object.
A fixture under `standard/conformance/fixtures/` passes schema validation with two task entries each declaring overlapping `scope.files_touched` paths.
`standard/package.json` reports version `0.5.0`.
`standard/CHANGELOG.md` contains a `## 0.5.0` heading.
All pre-existing conformance fixtures continue to pass the Vitest suite without any modifications.

tasks.title: reference-impl: new dag-overlap.ts module, savePlan integration, and tests
definition_of_done: New module `reference-impl/lib/dag-overlap.ts` exports `computeOverlapEdges(tasks: TaskDoc[]): TaskDagEdge[]` implementing the algorithm from the design spec: per-task `scope?.files_touched` extraction, path normalization (strip leading `./`, trailing `/`, canonicalize separators), pairwise intersection with lower-id-first deterministic ordering, deduplication by `(from.id, to.id)`.

`reference-impl/lib/plan.ts::savePlan` is updated to call `computeOverlapEdges(plan.tasks)` between schema validation and disk write, merge overlap edges into `plan.task_dag.edges` via set-union, and throw with message `"file overlap creates cycle: <task-id> ↔ <task-id> via <file>"` if the augmented DAG contains a cycle.

New test file `reference-impl/tests/dag-overlap.test.ts` contains exactly 12 test cases covering all scenarios enumerated in the design spec (empty list, single task, no overlap, one overlap, multiple overlapping files, three-task chain, path normalization, absent field, empty array, triangle, determinism, UTF-8 filenames).

`reference-impl/tests/plan.test.ts` is extended with 4 new cases covering: logical-only edges with file-overlap tasks produce merged output, idempotent re-save, cycle-introducing overlap throws with the documented message, and pre-existing overlap edges are not duplicated.
All 16 new test cases pass; no existing tests regress.
acceptance_criteria: `computeOverlapEdges([])` returns `[]`.
`computeOverlapEdges([a, b])` returns exactly one edge when `a` and `b` share at least one normalized file path, and `[]` when they share none.
`computeOverlapEdges` is deterministic: shuffling the input task array yields identical output edges in identical order.
Path normalization treats `./reference-impl/lib/cli.ts` and `reference-impl/lib/cli.ts` as the same file and emits exactly one edge.
Tasks without `scope.files_touched` (field absent) contribute zero overlap edges.
`savePlan` merges `computeOverlapEdges` results into `task_dag.edges` using set-union; re-saving a plan with already-merged overlap edges produces identical JSON output (idempotent).
`savePlan` throws an error whose message matches `"file overlap creates cycle: <task-id> ↔ <task-id> via <file>"` when inferred edges would introduce a cycle.
All 12 cases in `dag-overlap.test.ts` pass.
All 4 new cases in `plan.test.ts` pass.
No existing `reference-impl` tests regress.

tasks.title: reference-impl: Plan agent prompt update for scope.files_touched and gate-pending summary format
definition_of_done: `reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` contains a new instruction block near the existing `task_dag` guidance directing the agent to populate `scope.files_touched` per task by transcribing repo-root-relative POSIX paths from the brief's Parallel-DAG conflict guidance section.
`reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` contains the explicit directive: "Do NOT manually add edges for file overlap. The system computes them automatically when the Plan is saved."

The gate-pending summary template in `reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` is updated to group edges under `Logical:` and `Inferred from file overlap:` subsections, with the Plan agent computing the diff inline.

A regression test in `reference-impl/tests/skills.test.ts` or a new `reference-impl/tests/prompts.test.ts` asserts that `prompts/plan.md` contains both the literal `scope.files_touched` instruction string and the directive not to manually add overlap edges.
The new or extended test file passes; no existing tests regress.
acceptance_criteria: `reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` contains the substring `scope.files_touched` in the context of a task-population instruction.
`reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` contains the literal directive text instructing the agent not to manually add edges for file overlap.
`reference-impl/prompts/plan.md` contains a gate-pending summary template with `Logical:` and `Inferred from file overlap:` edge groupings.
The regression test in `skills.test.ts` or `prompts.test.ts` asserts both required strings are present in `prompts/plan.md` and passes green.
No existing prompt-related tests regress.
